title: The Brutal Math of Starting at 20 vs 30
hook_text: WAITING 10 YEARS COSTS YOU HALF A MILLION

beats.say: Waiting just ten years to start investing doesn't cost you ten years of savings—it costs you half a million dollars by the time you retire.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary commuter walking across a vast concrete plaza under cold blue hour light.

beats.say: How does pausing for a single decade erase a fortune?
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive steel bridge tower vanishing into heavy grey fog.

beats.say: Most people assume waiting till thirty just lops off the exact cash they failed to stash away.
beats.visual: Close up of worn leather gloves resting on wet asphalt under a single sodium streetlamp.
High angle shot of empty highway lanes cutting through dark pine trees at night.

beats.say: Let's run the exact math at an 8% return until age 65.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of rusty iron bolts on a damp concrete sea wall.

beats.say: If you invest $200 a month starting at age 20, you put in $96,000 over your working life.
beats.visual: Back view of a person standing at the edge of a rain-slick concrete observation deck.

beats.say: Compound interest turns that pile into a massive $698,202 by the time you hit 65.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone figure walking past towering concrete pillars in deep shadow.

beats.say: Now look what happens if you wait until age 30 to drop that exact same $200 a month.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of cold fluorescent lights flickering in an empty subway tunnel.

beats.say: You only put in $72,000, which sounds close enough.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of heavy raindrops hitting a puddle on dark stone.

beats.say: Except your total crashes down to $298,072.
beats.visual: Wide shot of a dark industrial rail yard under a heavy, overcast winter sky.

beats.say: Delaying ten years strips $400,130 straight out of your future account.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing on a windy mountain ridge overlooking a foggy valley.

beats.say: Time is the only asset you cannot buy back.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a vast empty highway stretching toward a dark horizon at dusk.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Single practical light cutting through dense fog on a cold concrete staircase.

caption: Waiting a decade before investing doesn't just lose you deposits—it starves your compounding engine of its best years. #money #personalfinance #investing #wealth #themaththeyhide
description: Comparing the math of investing $200 a month starting at age 20 versus waiting until 30, assuming an 8% return until age 65.
